name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Support one hand and the same-side knee on a bench, with the opposite foot on the floor.
Keep the back steady and let the dumbbell hang below the shoulder.
Pull the elbow toward the hip without twisting the torso.
Lower the weight with control; repeat on the other side.
cues: Keep the neck in line with the trunk.
Let the shoulder blade glide as the arm moves.
mistakes: Rotating the whole torso to lift the weight.
Shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.
breathing: Exhale while rowing; inhale while lowering.
